about.overview: Pipeline Industries is a progressive and innovative manufacturing and supply company serving heavy industries, infrastructural operations, marine, automotive, food, medical, and rural industries right through to the home handyman.

issues.title: Not mobile-friendly
issues.evidence: The page has no responsive viewport tag, so phones show a shrunken desktop layout.

issues.title: No easy way to get in touch
issues.evidence: No tap-to-call link and no enquiry form on the homepage.

issues.title: Images missing descriptions
issues.evidence: 27 of 27 images have no alt text (accessibility and SEO).
